document:
William Petre, 11th Baron Petre
William Henry Francis, 11th Baron Petre( 22 January 1793 – 3 July 1850) was an English nobleman, based in Essex. He was the first Baron Petre to take his seat in the House of Lords after the passing of the Catholic Relief Act 1829.
